# BlockDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasBlockDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasBlockDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasBlockDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasBlockDiagram.h"`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBlockDiagram> CreateBlockDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasBlockDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNodeCreated` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeCreated` | _Node created_ |
| `onNodeSelected` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeSelected` | _Node selected_ |
| `onNodeDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onNodeDoubleClick` | _Node double click_ |
| `onConnectionCreated` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, const std::string&)> onConnectionCreated` | _Connection created_ |
| `onEditModeChanged` | `std::function<void(EditMode)> onEditModeChanged` | _Edit mode changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### enum `NodeFace`

Identifies one face of a node's bounding box. Used by the connection anchor distribution logic so multiple connections that meet on the same face spread out along it instead of stacking on the midpoint.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Top` |  |
| `Right` |  |
| `Bottom` |  |
| `Left` |  |
